description: One wallet's win record in every canonical category it has a settled market in: wins, decided (wins plus losses) and win_rate per category, busiest first. The Esports record also lists each esports game it has a settled market in, and every record lists in scopes each part of the category it has a settled market in: an esports title, a soccer league or a registered league of another sport, by scope_key and display_name. The basis is every settled market at any size, so it differs from get_trader's categories expansion, which applies a 20 USD notional floor and an entry-price rule; neither corrects the other. A category with fewer decided markets than min_decided_for_win_rate keeps its counts with win_rate null and status not_enough_data. An absent category means no record, never a 0% record. A trader with no settled market returns empty records; an unknown address is a not_found error.

address.description: Wallet address (0x...), username, or trd_-prefixed trader id

category.description: One canonical category through the shared rollup: soccer and EPL reach Soccer, every esports label reaches Esports, football is American football, and sports returns every record but Esports. A value matching no record returns empty records. A game or a league is not a filter: ask for its category and read games or scopes
